name: Pressurised module door

parts.name: airlock shell
parts.massBasis: Open-ended rectangular pressure shell ~8 m x 8 m x 3.8 m with 7-layer wall (6 mm Al pressure skin, structural ribs, insulation, MLI, micrometeorite shield, outer skin). Lateral area ~123 m², effective wall thickness ~25 mm, effective density ~2300 kg/m³. Mass concentrated at perimeter walls giving higher cross-section variance (~0.21) than length variance (~0.08, near uniform). Slight z-offset for heavier base flange.

parts.name: hatch lid
parts.massBasis: Hatch lid spanning ~4.1 m x 4.3 m with 4 material groups (Al face plate, internal ribs/frame, elastomer seal ring, latch and hinge hardware). Designed for ~100 kPa differential over ~17.8 m²; plate + frame thickness ~0.15-0.25 m. The 3.1 m z-extent includes hinge swing envelope and mechanism depth. Near-solid distribution with moderate hollowness gives variance near 1/13. CoM slightly toward hinge side.
